summary: The Naigaon Social Service Society, located in Dadar East, Mumbai, near B. J.
description:
The Naigaon Social Service Society, located in Dadar East, Mumbai, near B. J. Deorukhkar Road and
Lok Seva School, provides early childhood education through its Playgroup and Nursery. It also
conducts tailoring and sewing classes to equip women with practical skills and promote self-reliance.
The institution primarily serves children and women from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.
On 28th October 2026, RCMM members Rtns. Arati, Asavari, Shaila and Swati visited the Society and
donated educational toys for its childcare centre, along with mirrors and mannequins for the tailoring
classes. These contributions will help create a more engaging learning environment for young children
while supporting women in developing their sewing skills and pursuing livelihood opportunities.
